text: Mark Cuban made an investment in DUDE Products after its founders appeared on ABC's Shark Tank in 2015 and remains an investor; TSG Consumer's June 2025 investment announcement describes him as continuing to back the company.
short: Mark Cuban: DUDE Products investor since Shark Tank (2015).

source.name: San Jose Earthquakes – 'San Jose Earthquakes and DUDE Wipes Announce Official Back-of-Jersey Partnership' (About DUDE Wipes)
source.quote: In 2015, DUDE Products appeared on ABC's show Shark Tank, where they received an investment deal from Mark Cuban
source.note: TSG Consumer's own 23 June 2025 release says 'Long time Shark Tank investor Mark Cuban is also continuing to bet on the DUDEs'.
